description: This file implements a Service Worker for handling trace loading, snapshot serving, and resource management in a web-based trace viewer application. It manages trace data, handles fetch events, and communicates progress to clients.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Represents a client with an ID, URL, and message posting capability.

classes.name: ServiceWorkerGlobalScope
classes.description: Type definition for the global scope of the service worker, including event listener methods and registration info.

classes.name: LoadedTrace
classes.description: Holds the trace loader and snapshot server instances for a loaded trace.

classes.name: FetchEvent
classes.description: Represents a fetch event with request details and response handling.

methods.name: simulateRestart
methods.description: Clears loaded traces and client trace URL mappings to simulate a service worker restart.

methods.name: loadTraceOrError
methods.description: Attempts to load a trace and returns either the loaded trace or an error response.

methods.name: loadTrace
methods.description: Loads a trace given a client ID and URL, caching the result.

methods.name: innerLoadTrace
methods.description: Performs the actual loading of a trace, including error handling and snapshot server setup.

methods.name: doFetch
methods.description: Handles fetch events, serving trace data, snapshots, or static resources based on request URL.

methods.name: downloadHeaders
methods.description: Generates headers for file download responses based on URL search parameters.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection of unused trace data and client mappings.

methods.name: clientProgress
methods.description: Creates a progress callback that posts progress messages to a client.

methods.name: noopProgress
methods.description: A no-operation progress function that does nothing.

methods.name: isLiveTrace
methods.description: Determines if a trace URI points to a live trace based on its URL.
